reason: Bridges Xcode's headless MCP interface into DSH, primarily enabling agents to build, test, debug, inspect, and interact with Apple projects and simulators.

summaries.zh: 将 Xcode 的无界面 MCP 能力接入 DSH，使智能体能够构建、测试、调试和检查 Apple 项目并与模拟器交互。
summaries.en: Connects Xcode’s headless MCP capabilities to DSH so agents can build, test, debug, inspect Apple projects, and interact with simulators.

capabilities: Spawns the Xcode mcpbridge subprocess through xcrun
Exposes Xcode headless tools for project creation, opening, building, and testing
Controls simulators with tap, typing, and swipe interactions
Reads screenshots, accessibility hierarchies, and OSLog output
Forwards tool calls and results between DSH and Xcode over MCP JSON-RPC
